findings.passage: “We have some of the most conservative states in the country that are ahead of us on keeping people safe at the polls,” Brennan said.
findings.note: Quoted by WVIA/WITF about his bill to bar guns from polling places; he points to other states that already have such bans.

HB 2077 would make it a misdemeanor to have a firearm at a polling place, with exceptions for on-duty police and military; owners could leave a gun in a vehicle. Brennan is listed as sponsor with Rep. Mary Jo Daley (WVIA, 2024-02-16 says he co-sponsored it).
